_comment: Digit runs in this app's own files that src/mask.js would hide as phone numbers but are not phone numbers, each with the reason. Checked by tests/non-phone-digit-runs.test.js; keys are the run's digits only.

runs.1234567890: Sequential-digit fixture standing in for a purchase-order number and a part-number SKU.
runs.202609130042: Quote-reference fixture: a date (2026-09-13) and a sequence number.
runs.2500000: Quantity fixture (2.5 million units) written without separators.
runs.370400440532013000: The account part of DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00, the standard documentation example IBAN.
runs.0900170001614960123: Office hours (0900-1700) glued to Ofcom's fictional 0161 496 0123, to show the pair is masked together.
runs.5660969858: GitHub issue-comment id in a linked PR #524 review URL (docs/pr-body.md), not a phone number.
